results.content: As a first-time author, Reedsy has been an absolute game changer in my publishing journey. Coming into the process without much knowledge about editing or what to expect, I found the platform incredibly user-friendly and supportive. Reedsy made it easy to understand the different levels of editing and helped me connect with experienced professionals who truly elevated my work. One of the best parts of using Reedsy is how easy it is to reach out to multiple editors. It removes a lot of the stress and gives you flexibility—if one editor isn’t the right fit, you still have other great options lined up. Overall, I highly recommend Reedsy to any writer—whether you’re just starting out or further along in your publishing process. The platform takes something that can feel overwhelming and makes [...] Reedsy made this collaboration not just possible, but effortless. Discovery was frictionless—I found exactly the right professional for my project—and the platform’s messaging, file sharing, and milestone tools kept everything clear, fast, and on-track. Deadlines were visible, drafts were easy to exchange, and payments were simple and secure. It felt like having a smart production office wrapped around my book. Working with Zeynep through Reedsy was a model of efficiency and craft. The shared workspace let us iterate cleanly on the query, synopsis, and excerpt, while keeping every edit, comment, and decision in one tidy thread. For a first step beyond self-publishing, that structure—and Reedsy’s reliability—was priceless. Kraa

There is an abundance of choice when it comes to text editors, but they all tend to fall into one of two categories. Either their interface is too cluttered and bursting with features – or they are too simple and limiting.  
  
With Kraa, we tried to do the impossible. Create an editor that's pleasant to use, simple, clutter-free. And yet – it can take anything you throw at it.  
  
This update also includes a voice control feature unlike anything you have used before.
